InfoTextAboutMe: I develop modern websites and digital experiences with a focus on design, performance, and usability. I especially enjoy tackling complex development challenges and creating creative user interfaces. With thoughtful animations and a clear design language, I create websites that not only look impressive but are also intuitive and enjoyable to use. My services include the development of customized web solutions for various industries and use cases – from modern restaurant, medical, and business websites to e-commerce solutions as well as smaller entertainment websites and web-based projects. Each website is individually tailored to the requirements and goals of the respective project. In addition, I offer logo design as well as the creation of German and English-language web presences. I also provide support with the technical implementation and long-term maintenance of your digital presence. This includes domain setup and management, hosting solutions, and the technical maintenance of the website. Through a service agreement, I take care of smaller adjustments, updates, and optimizations to ensure that your digital presence remains reliable, up to date, and fully functional over time.
